description:
Return technologies deterministically detected on one specified public domain; deterministic observations, not an exhaustive proof that no other technology exists.
USE WHEN: agent needs technologies currently detected on one specific public domain.
DO NOT USE WHEN: vendor -> current confirmed customers; vendor + time -> ADDED/REMOVED; competitor replacement/switch signals.
USE installed-base-intelligence FOR: confirmed customer domains using a technology/vendor.
USE change-intelligence FOR: durable ADDED/REMOVED changes for a vendor within a UTC time window.
USE competitor-switch-intelligence FOR: competitor replacement/switch signals.

domain.description: Public domain to scan for detectable technologies; localhost and IP literals are rejected.
domain.title: Domain

technologies.description: Deterministically detected technologies ordered by canonical key ascending.

categories.description: Technology categories from registry metadata when available.

name.description: Human-readable technology/vendor name when available from registry metadata.

technology.description: Canonical technology registry key (e.g., yotpo, judgeme, klaviyo).
